sentence: Trim the huge overgrown shrub next to the house.

observation.model_notes: Photo 2 shows a different house/property (white siding, front porch, driveway with Jeep, small well-kept shrubs, flowering tree) than photo 1 (reddish wood fence with a large columnar shrub mass and a white roof/structure behind it). It's unclear whether both photos are meant to document the same job site. The shrub_trimming scope below is based entirely on photo 1, since photo 2 does not show the shrub described in the request. Also unclear from either photo whether the plant is a true shrub or a multi-trunk small tree (arborvitae/juniper type), and which yard section it actually sits in (front, side, or back) since no house entry or street-facing view of it is shown.

counting_evidence.note: One large, overgrown multi-stemmed shrub (columnar evergreen, arborvitae/juniper type) growing against a wood fence, with several upright leaders rising well above the fence line toward the roof behind it; base shows an old cut stump, indicating prior pruning.

evidence.note: Shrub mass dominates the frame, multiple green columnar branches emerging from one base area, overgrown well past the fence height with some already-cut branch debris piled beside a trash can nearby.

service_lines.uncertain: Cannot confirm from the photo whether this is one shrub with multiple stems or several columnar shrubs planted close together and merged; also cannot confirm the yard section (front/side/back) since no wider establishing shot of the property is provided.
